ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white surface area and 30% low-intensity black pigmentation and marginal boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located high-intensity white fields on both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the distal tips, trailing edges, and in a series of linear vertical streaks (rake marks) traversing the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; the lower vertex depth is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits distinct high-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixel depth) against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the leading edges tapering into acute distal tips; trailing edges demonstrate a symmetrical concave curve toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular spots near the right distal tip, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of parallel and intersecting low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) covering both lobes, with a higher density of distinct lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark patterning across the ventral surface; irregular jagged contours on the right trailing edge indicating prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent low-intensity black pigmentation area surrounding the median notch extending into the lower fluke body.
